fusion.method: Greedy one-to-one cross-model association. Candidate pair allowed when equivalent diameters are within 2.86x and either axis-aligned ellipse-box IoU >= 0.18 or center distance <= 28% of mean equivalent diameter. Consensus uses TimberVision ellipse geometry; unmatched detections from either model are kept.
fusion.note: This is a union ensemble, not a trained/calibrated fusion model. Unmatched predictions may be false positives; the photo has no ground-truth labels.
